name: Simplicial Covering Voxelization
aliases: Voxelization of solids using simplicial coverings
definition: A method to rasterize and voxelize 3D solids by representing the solid as a sum of signed tetrahedra (pyramids) formed by joining the solid's faces to an arbitrary point (origin/centroid), then using a presence buffer to toggle voxel states.
summary: Simplicial Covering Voxelization is a single-pass method that voxelizes 3D solids by decomposing surfaces into tetrahedra and using a presence buffer to toggle voxel states based on coverage parity.
